Shreyas Iyer Climbs ICC Rankings After Century Against West Indies

Shreyas Iyer has gained 18 places in the ICC rankings to enter the top-10 T20 batters after scoring a century against the West Indies in Lucknow. Iyer became the first Indian captain to score a T20I century while chasing a target.
